reconstruction_notes.en: Original living whole-organism interpretation: soft internal trunk and short projecting head enclosed by a naturally tapered tube carapace open at both ends, proportionate large paired eyes, simplified internal paddles and a connected telson with two lateral blades plus one vertical blade. Nominal0.1m tube/body scale, muted palette and static pose are art choices. No closed bivalve capsule, lateral long-spine substitute, reused Dollocaris/Isoxys mesh, exact segment/limb count, fine head-organ or swimming-mechanism claim. Closed semantic roots overlap organically while shell apertures remain actual geometry.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创全体生活复原：柔软内躯与短前伸头部包于自然渐收、两端开口的筒甲中，具比例克制的大型双眼、简化内侧桨肢，以及两侧各一叶和一片竖叶组成的相连三叶尾。0.1米名义筒甲/体尺度、柔和配色及静姿为美术设定。不做封闭双瓣囊甲或长侧刺替代，不复用Dollocaris/Isoxys网格，不主张精确体节/肢数、细小头器官或游泳机制。封闭语义部件在根部自然交叠，筒甲孔口保留真实几何。

reconstruction_notes.en: Geological-form artistic concept: twelve-metre representative landscape extent with a broad cropped shore-connected root narrowing into one projecting low sand tongue and a curved free tip. Original nominal extent, crest heights, curvature and sand palette, not a complete mapped coast, exact ancient place/age or sediment-transport simulation. Water and display scenery are not included. Original landscape/coast facets preserved.

structural_scope.en: Original Capinatator-inspired slender continuous flexible marine body with two opposed arrays of modest curved head spines. Calm static pose and rounded economical spine tips, no enlarged fangs or predation action. Source microscopic counts simplified, no Yale artwork or external model copied; no precise locomotion claim.
structural_scope.zh: 原创Capinatator启发细长连续柔躯海生形态，头端两侧相对克制弧棘阵列。友善静态姿势与省简钝尖，无夸张獠牙或捕食动作；微棘数量省简，不复制Yale艺术图或外部模型，不承诺精确运动机制。
